name: respawn_voice
caption: which voice do I TRUST? 😳
premise: In this world, the first time you die you hear one sentence from your future self. It saved my brother from lava and my sister from a zombie. Today I fell off a cliff and heard mine: DON'T SLEEP IN THE NEW BED. I respawned in a field, because my bed was gone: Dad had built me a new one. He said it's safer, then nailed my door shut. That night a second voice, my own, said: SLEEP IN THE BED, OR YOU'LL RESPAWN SOMEWHERE THAT ISN'T HOME. But I wasn't dead. And the first voice sounded grandpa old.
answer: Voice 1 (don't sleep). Part 2: the rule gives one sentence, on your first death. Voice 2 came to a living player, so it isn't future me: it's whatever wants me in that bed. A bed sets your respawn point, so one night in it and every death brings me back to that nailed-shut room, forever. 'Somewhere that isn't home' was the truth told as a threat: the field was me being free. And voice 1 sounded grandpa old because the me who never sleeps in that bed gets to grow old. Clues for 1: voice 2 came while I was alive (full hearts, no death screen) and it's a second sentence when the rule gives one; Dad took the old bed and nailed the door shut the moment I was inside. Clues for 2: I really did respawn in a field with no home bed (vanilla: a missing bed sends you to world spawn), exactly what voice 2 warns of; voice 1 sounded far too old to be me; a zombie is at the window, so the nailed door looks like protection (and CLOSE THE DOOR saved my sister). Both ways: the nailed door, and the old voice.

lines.text: In my world, / the FIRST time / you DIE, / you hear / ONE sentence / from your / FUTURE self.
My brother / heard, DON'T / mine the GOLD. / Behind it / was LAVA.
My sister / heard, CLOSE / the DOOR. / That night / a ZOMBIE / came KNOCKING.
Today / I fell / off a CLIFF. / And I / heard MINE.
DON'T SLEEP / in the / NEW bed.
I respawned / in a FIELD. / My bed / was GONE.
Dad had / BUILT me / a NEW one. / He said / it's SAFER.
Then he / NAILED / my door / SHUT.
That night / I heard / a SECOND / voice. / MY voice.
SLEEP in / the bed, / or you'll / RESPAWN / somewhere / that ISN'T / home.
And the / FIRST voice / sounded OLD. / GRANDPA old.
